Successful mirror cleanup is memoized exactly once; its real `rm` rejection remains a fatal shutdown failure. Added owner-seam regressions for exact cause/classification/target/disposition preservation, no shutdown replay, and retained-evidence survival, plus a production role lifecycle regression proving accepted snapshot failure locks spawning, settles, emits a refused V2 receipt, and shuts down without infrastructure failure. Compatibility exports were not touched.

Verification passed: focused Reviewer Agent/role tests (27/27), typecheck, tracked artifact regeneration, isolated-HOME full suite (328 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed), installed-tarball Reviewer lifecycle and cold-installed Recorder within the full suite, npm pack dry-run/prepack (99 files), and git diff check. Worktree is clean.
